source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 4, Theorem 4.1 and paragraphs immediately following it
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper assumes time-homogeneous finite-memory effects for Theorem 4.1, states that it does not establish analogues of its earlier inference theorems for the event-study estimator, and says the time-varying dynamic DATE equation is beyond the paper's scope.

The abstract states that the paper constructs cross-fit doubly robust estimators using separate nuisance-training subsamples and establishes fast remainder rates for average linear functionals of conditional expectations.

The paper states that its doubly robust procedures may fail to be regular when only one nuisance is consistently estimated and develops additional nuisance corrections in a partially linear-regression setting.

The paper gives necessary-and-sufficient factorization conditions for discrete graphical/log-linear exponential models through toric algebra, rather than a classification of ordered DATE loading-kernel intersections.
